title: Christopher R NDE 3056
content: I was trying to unplug a record player. It was plugged into an extension cord. I put it in my mouth and tried to pull it apart. That's when I was electrocuted. My eyes rolled back into my head. I could see the electricity going through my body. Then I left my body. My brother was on the bed, and I was looking down on him. I could see the whole room. It was like being in my body, but I was not in my body. Then I saw a tunnel. It was made of bricks, just like a brick road, only curved like a tunnel. I went through the tunnel. At the end, there was a bright, white light. When I went through the white light, there was a man. I say man, because it was a man's voice. This person was in a white robe. I did not see a face. I did not want to go back through the tunnel; it was so peaceful. I wanted to stay, but was told I had to go back. There was a lot I had yet to learn. I went back through the tunnel and was back in the bedroom. I saw my brother on the bed, and then I slammed back into my body. I pulled the plug from my mouth, went into the bathroom and looked in the mirror. Then I went and showed my parents. They took me off to the clinic.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Accident Other I was happy. I was being electrocuted.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Presence of deceased persons | Light | Special Knowledge | Life review
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal
elements.At what time during the experience were: I was alert the whole time.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes I went through a tunnel, a brick tunnel, with a white light at the end of it.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes I met a person at the end of the white light. I did not see its face, but it had a man's voice. I was told to go back, because I still had more to learn.
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes It was a very bright, white light, with a feeling of calm.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: Yes I seem to be attracted to metaphysics.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes I seem to be attracted to metaphysics.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Yes I feel to this day that we are only here to learn. I have been more open. I see things and know when some things are going to happen.
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes When I have a relationship, it always seems to end because I seem to know what's going on - stuff that men aren't supposed to know. It's hard to explain.
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes I find that people get scared when I talk about it.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes I see ghosts sometimes, but I'm used to it. I just ignore it.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: Yes, the leaving my body and the out of body experience.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes In 1996, I started telling my family - thirty years after it happened. Everybody just seems to be scared.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real. I was scared. I was only eight years old. I thought everybody would think I was crazy, or making it all up.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real. I still at times have a hard time with it. I was raised to be grounded, but I'm not open. It's been hard. They treated me like I was slow. I had a hard time learning, but I went to college.
elements.At any time in your life, has anything e: Yes I relive it almost every day. Sometimes, I go through the tunnel and ask for help when I'm trying to win at bingo - and win almost every time.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: Yes. If it happens to anybody, just listen and don't be scared. Also, listen to little kids. They are more open than adults.
elements.Are there any other questions that we co: It's hard. At this time I don't know.
